jobs.title: Director, International Business Transformation & Strategy Execution (flexible location)
jobs.description:
Chez ABB, nous aidons les industries à être plus efficaces et plus durables, et chaque personne ici contribue à cet impact. Vous aurez le pouvoir d’agir, le soutien nécessaire pour évoluer et la fierté de participer aux résultats que nous créons ensemble. Joignez-vous à nous et contribuez à ce qui fait avancer le monde.

The work model for the role is:
Hybrid

Your Role And Responsibilities

This Director role is a strategic transformation position within ABB's NEMA International division, reporting to the EVP International Sales. The role is pivotal in building a scalable international business platform by strengthening alignment across Regions, Business Lines and functions, removing structural barriers to growth and driving implementation of the Stabilize-Optimize-Scale roadmap. The successful candidate will drive business transformation across regions while building scalable operating foundations, combining expertise in strategy execution, operating-model redesign, business process management, change leadership, and executive influence within a complex global matrix.

The work model for the role is: hybrid ;

The role is contributing to the Motion NEMA Motors division globally.

International travel of approximately 30-40% will be required for the role.

You Will Be Mainly Accountable For

Own and drive the NEMA International transformation roadmap aligned with the Stabilize-Optimize-Scale journey, translating strategy into prioritized initiatives with clear outcomes, milestones and success measures while maintaining visibility of progress and risks to leadership.
Act as senior integrator between NEMA International and Global Business Lines, establishing governance mechanisms and cross-functional commitments that align product, portfolio, and investment priorities with international market requirements while escalating critical dependencies that constrain growth.
Lead resolution of systemic barriers at the interfaces between International Sales, Global Operations, IT, Finance, HR and other supporting functions, converting fragmented issues into prioritized root-cause initiatives with clear accountability and measurable outcomes.
Serve as custodian of the NEMA International target operating model, ensuring organizational accountabilities, governance, processes, technology and capabilities evolve coherently to enable profitable international growth, from stabilization through optimization and scale, while designing the organization for future growth and acquisitions.
Lead an executive-level International Transformation Office that manages the transformation portfolio, governance cadence, dependency view and risk escalation, mobilizing cross-functional workstreams and intervening to resolve ownership gaps, resource constraints or delayed decisions.
Lead adoption of the new international organization and ways of working through change leadership, stakeholder engagement and capability building, while establishing a continuous improvement framework that connects frontline issues to structural business improvements and embeds continuous improvement into leadership accountability.

Qualifications For The Role

Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in business transformation, strategy execution, operating-model design, commercial excellence, enterprise program leadership or management consulting.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Strategy, Operations, Information Systems or a related discipline.
Experience in an internal strategy, transformation, business excellence or consulting role.
Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation across multiple geographies or business units.
Proven ability to align senior stakeholders and functions behind a shared agenda without relying on direct authority.
Experience translating strategy into executable roadmaps, governance, operating mechanisms and measurable outcomes.
Strong business acumen and ability to connect transformation to customer value, growth, margin, cash, productivity and organizational capability.
Excellent executive communication, facilitation and synthesis skills.
Ability to constructively challenge established practices and navigate ambiguity with pace and judgement.
Familiarity with international commercial models, CRM/ERP environments and end-to-end customer processes.
Experience in an industrial, manufacturing, electromechanical or B2B technology environment is an advantage. Recognized transformation, change management, Lean, Six Sigma or program-management certification is a plus.
Fluent English language skills.

More About Us

ABB’s NEMA Motors Division is a marketer, designer and manufacturer that offers Baldor-Reliance® industrial electric motors, primarily in North America. The Division focuses on quality, reliability and efficiency to provide a comprehensive offering of NEMA motors in the market across most industrial segments and applications.

We value people from different backgrounds. Apply today for your next career step within ABB and visit www.abb.com to learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. #MyABBStory

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website
www.abb.com
.

_________________

Directeur(-trice) transformation des activités internationales et exécution de la stratégie (lieu de travail flexible)

Nos convictions

Chez ABB, nous nous engageons à relever les défis mondiaux. Nos valeurs fondamentales — la bienveillance, le courage, la curiosité et la collaboration —combinées à notre engagement envers la diversité, l’inclusion et l’égalité des chances, sont au cœur de notre volonté de donner à chacun et chacune les moyens de créer des solutions durables.

Écrivez le prochain chapitre de votre histoire chez ABB.

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Ce poste de direction est axé sur la transformation stratégique au sein de la division NEMA International d’ABB et relève du vice-président exécutif, ventes internationales. Il joue un rôle essentiel dans la mise en place d’une plateforme d’affaires internationales évolutive en renforçant l’alignement entre les régions, les secteurs d’activité et les fonctions, en éliminant les obstacles structurels à la croissance et en pilotant la mise en œuvre de la feuille de route Stabiliser-Optimiser-Déployer à grande échelle. La personne retenue pilotera la transformation des activités dans les différentes régions tout en établissant des fondations opérationnelles évolutives, en mettant à profit son expertise en exécution de la stratégie, en refonte des modèles opérationnels, en gestion des processus d’affaires, en leadership du changement et en influence auprès de la haute direction dans une structure matricielle mondiale complexe.

Le mode de travail pour ce poste est : hybride;

Ce poste contribue aux activités de la division Moteurs NEMA du secteur Motion à l’échelle mondiale.

Ce poste exige des déplacements internationaux représentant environ 30 à 40 % du temps de travail.

Vos Principales Responsabilités Seront Les Suivantes

Prendre en charge et piloter la feuille de route de transformation de NEMA International, en cohérence avec le parcours Stabiliser-Optimiser-Déployer à grande échelle, en traduisant la stratégie en initiatives prioritaires assorties de résultats, de jalons et de critères de réussite clairs, tout en assurant à la direction une visibilité sur les progrès et les risques.
Agir comme principal point d’intégration entre NEMA International et les secteurs d’activité mondiaux, en établissant des mécanismes de gouvernance et des engagements interfonctionnels qui alignent les priorités en matière de produits, de portefeuille et d’investissements sur les exigences des marchés internationaux, tout en portant à l’attention de la direction les interdépendances critiques qui freinent la croissance.
Piloter la résolution des obstacles systémiques aux interfaces entre les ventes internationales, les opérations mondiales, les TI, les finances, les RH et les autres fonctions de soutien, en regroupant les problèmes isolés en initiatives prioritaires visant leurs causes fondamentales, assorties de responsabilités claires et de résultats mesurables.
Veiller au maintien du modèle opérationnel cible de NEMA International, en s’assurant que les responsabilités organisationnelles, la gouvernance, les processus, les technologies et les capacités évoluent de façon cohérente pour soutenir une croissance internationale rentable, de la stabilisation à l’optimisation, puis au déploiement à grande échelle, tout en concevant l’organisation en fonction de sa croissance et de ses acquisitions futures.
Diriger un bureau de transformation internationale au niveau de la haute direction, responsable du portefeuille de transformation, du rythme de gouvernance, du suivi des interdépendances et du signalement des risques, en mobilisant les chantiers interfonctionnels et en intervenant pour résoudre les lacunes dans l’attribution des responsabilités, les contraintes de ressources ou les retards décisionnels.
Piloter l’adoption de la nouvelle organisation internationale et des nouvelles façons de travailler grâce au leadership du changement, à la mobilisation des parties prenantes et au développement des capacités, tout en établissant un cadre d’amélioration continue qui relie les problèmes de première ligne aux améliorations structurelles des activités et intègre l’amélioration continue aux responsabilités de la direction.

Qualifications Requises Pour Le Poste

Au moins 10 ans d’expérience avec des responsabilités croissantes en transformation des activités, en exécution de la stratégie, en conception de modèles opérationnels, en excellence commerciale, en direction de programmes d’entreprise ou en conseil en gestion.
Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en administration des affaires, en génie, en stratégie, en gestion des opérations, en systèmes d’information ou dans une discipline connexe.
Expérience dans un rôle interne en stratégie, en transformation, en excellence opérationnelle ou en consultation.
Expérience démontrée dans la direction de transformations complexes et interfonctionnelles touchant plusieurs régions géographiques ou unités d’affaires.
Capacité éprouvée à rallier les parties prenantes de la haute direction et les fonctions autour de priorités communes, sans s’appuyer sur une autorité hiérarchique directe.
Expérience dans la traduction de la stratégie en feuilles de route réalisables, en structures de gouvernance, en mécanismes opérationnels et en résultats mesurables.
Solide sens des affaires et capacité à relier la transformation à la valeur pour la clientèle, à la croissance, aux marges, aux flux de trésorerie, à la productivité et aux capacités organisationnelles.
Excellentes aptitudes en communication auprès de la haute direction, en animation et en synthèse.
Capacité à remettre en question les pratiques établies de façon constructive et à évoluer dans l’ambiguïté avec rapidité et discernement.
Connaissance des modèles commerciaux internationaux, des environnements de gestion de la relation client (CRM) et de planification des ressources de l’entreprise (ERP), ainsi que des processus clients de bout en bout.
Une expérience dans un environnement industriel, manufacturier, électromécanique ou de technologies interentreprises (B2B) constitue un atout. Une certification reconnue en transformation, en gestion du changement, en Lean, en Six Sigma ou en gestion de programmes constitue un atout.
Maîtrise de l’anglais.

Pour en savoir plus sur nous

La division Moteurs NEMA d’ABB commercialise, conçoit et fabrique des moteurs électriques industriels Baldor-Reliance®, principalement en Amérique du Nord. jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. If contacted in relation to a job opportunity or testing, you should advise the member of the Talent Acquisition team in a timely fashion of any disabilities that requires accommodation measures in order to enable you to be assessed in a fair and equitable manner.

Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

No agency or telephone inquiries please.
